title: SignalSpec
description: Registration record for a signal plugin (packages/falcon_core/signals/<family>/<name>.py). Python interface: `async def run(ctx: SignalContext) -> list[Evidence]`; must respect timeout_ms, must not raise (return Evidence with error set), must not do network I/O except through ctx.http (SSRF-guarded, egress proxy) and ctx.cache.

emits.description: Evidence signal names this plugin can emit; each must be listed in docs/SCORING.md.

feature_names.description: Numeric features fed to the T1 classifier.
